artifact.name: Frozen Advanced06 initial review
artifact.scope: Advanced only; four before/candidate view pairs; head06/machinery06/body05/metal05

question: Is Advanced06 a defensible source-aligned gain, and what blocks the complete target?
decision_scope: Evidence integrity and technical reviewability of the restored initial Advanced freeze. Does not approve source likeness, three-era completion, browser visual parity, owner acceptance or release.
rationale: Matched comparison controls, exact scoped texture bytes, preserved receiving payloads and actual static GLB geometry/UV/material coverage support reviewing visible gain. Those technical gates cannot establish the gain itself or final likeness. Frozen-custody violation was observed and byte-exactly repaired; it must remain in the chain of custody.

authority.limit: Live GitHub main goal still ends at Milestone2b budget stop; architect-supervised continuation is recorded in local goal and direct owner-thread authority, not yet published main. No shared-main synchronization claimed.

independence.source_family: Same pinned images, scripts, receipts and native assets as implementation; no external holdout.
independence.model_family: Inherited parent model; initial roles share model/source family. Agreement is correlated and cannot establish acceptance.
independence.permissions: Read-only repository inspection, writes confined to requested /tmp review outputs; no installs, children, cloud asset transmission, publication or source edits.
independence.holdout: None; all pinned sources are development references visible to optimizer.
